ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (17) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Сознание» (soznanie, 'consciousness') keeps the full repetition of the opening thought, which the website draft had shortened, and «духовное начало» (dukhovnoe nachalo) in the Channing passage is 'spiritual principle'; «божество» (bozhestvo) is 'divinity'. The Vishnu Purana attribution keeps «Браминская мудрость» (Braminskaya mudrost', 'Brahmanic wisdom'), which the website draft had dropped.
